It must be incredibly discouraging to face that repeatedly."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yes, and it's starting to affect my motivation. I feel so undervalued."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Feeling undervalued at work can be so draining. Do you have any support or allies in the workplace that you can talk to about this?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've mended things with a coworker recently, which has helped a bit. But it's still so lonely dealing with this."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm glad to hear that you have someone you can at least partially lean on. Have you thought about addressing this with anyone higher up or in HR?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I have, but I'm worried it might make things worse with my supervisor if they find out."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a valid concern. It's important to weigh the potential outcomes. How are you handling the stress outside of work?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, not well. The stress is impacting my personal life too, especially after my recent breakup."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like you're dealing with a lot on your plate all at once. It must be hard to find peace right now."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It is. I'm trying to stay connected with family, but I still feel quite lost."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Reconnecting with family after the memorial service was a positive step.
